## CoreWeave Sells Off as Debt-Financing Concerns and Rising Rates Pressure AI Capex Thesis

CoreWeave's model is levered to accessible debt; rate-driven financing risk is a structural threat to the AI hyperscaler buildout narrative and is a second-order read on capex sustainability for the entire AI infrastructure theme.

- CoreWeave shares fell sharply on the Aug. 18 session per headline framing.
- Named catalysts: debt-financing concerns and capital spending pressures, both explicitly linked to rising interest rates.
- The framing is macro-driven — rising rates are directly challenging the AI infrastructure capex funding model.
- Story reflects broader market anxiety about debt-financed AI buildout under a higher-for-longer rate environment.
